executiveSummary:
Period overview: Last 30 days produced 4,685 security events (SSE 4,337; endpoint 347; network 1) and 348 incidents (318 medium, 28 high, 2 critical). Assets: 745 active devices (618 Windows 11). Users: 520 total; 388 medium-risk, 4 high-risk. SSE top apps: WhatsApp 782, OpenAI‑ChatGPT 718. Endpoint automated remediation handled removable media and process termination attempts.

Top cross-domain risks: 1) Endpoint compromise via malicious binaries and security‑process termination — enforce EDR hardening. 2) Excessive web denials and risky app use (SSE/CASB) — tighten policies and DLP. 3) Concentration of Windows 11 endpoints and high-risk users — prioritize patching, identity reviews, and targeted monitoring.

findings.title: Unauthorized file operations (Endpoint)
findings.description: 2 critical unauthorized file operation attempts observed on assets FISI and VP6-NRB; resolved but indicates data access risk.

findings.title: Security process termination attempts
findings.description: Multiple 'Attempt To Terminate Cynet Process' events across hosts (PKFMSA-LAO, L5ZQ-NRB, F15X-NRB).

findings.title: High volume blocked web requests (SSE)
findings.description: Users zzuberi (690), iwanjiru (260), iwamala (234) show repeated denied web requests indicating risky behavior.

findings.title: Port scanning detected (Network)
findings.description: Network activity inspection recorded TCP port scan targeting adikinim-KLA; no follow-on events.

findings.title: Concentrated Windows 11 estate and high‑risk users
findings.description: 618 of 745 devices run Windows 11; 4 users flagged high-risk (iraintern, mmuthoni, vkibe, ynanzingwa).

recommendations.title: Elevate endpoint containment
recommendations.description: Apply restrictive isolation on hosts with recent critical/ high detections and increase EDR telemetry retention to 90 days.

recommendations.title: Harden security agent protection
recommendations.description: Prevent termination of Cynet and similar agents via tamper‑protection policies and log all termination attempts centrally.

recommendations.title: Tighten CASB/web policies
recommendations.description: Block high‑risk app categories, enforce DLP on top blocked users, and investigate repeated denied requests.

recommendations.title: Network monitoring and blocking
recommendations.description: Add automated blocking for confirmed external scans; trigger triage on port‑scan detections.

recommendations.title: User risk remediation & asset baseline
recommendations.description: Remediate 4 high‑risk users, enforce MFA, and validate patch status across Windows 11 fleet.

riskMatrix.treatmentPlan: Contain infected hosts, increase EDR detection rules and telemetry.
Enforce CASB DLP, block risky apps, monitor top users.
Immediate user reviews, MFA, and access reduction.
Automate scan blocking and escalate repeated probes.

sections.title: Endpoint Security
sections.content: 347 endpoint events: 317 medium, 28 high, 2 critical. Key patterns: removable media blocks and attempts to terminate security agent. Auto-remediation applied; several resolved incidents.
sections.keyInsight: EDR triggering; enforce tamper protection and longer telemetry.

sections.title: Web / CASB & Network Security
sections.content: SSE: 4,337 events (92 critical, 779 high). Top apps: WhatsApp 782, OpenAI‑ChatGPT 718. Network: 1 medium port‑scan event. Primary vector: web/CASB (3,742 CASB, 595 web_proxy).
sections.keyInsight: Web/CASB drives event volume; focus DLP and app controls.

sections.title: Incident Response
sections.content: 348 incidents total: 318 medium, 28 high, 2 critical. 337 resolved, 11 open. Recent resolved criticals were unauthorized file operations on endpoints.
sections.keyInsight: High resolution rate; open incidents require prioritization.

sections.title: Asset & Identity (Inventory & Users)
sections.content: 745 active devices (618 Windows 11, 84 Windows 10, 43 servers). 520 users generated 113,762 requests; 388 medium‑risk, 4 high‑risk users flagged for immediate review.
sections.keyInsight: Concentrated Windows 11 estate and several high‑risk users need targeted controls.

complianceMapping.gap: MFA enforcement inconsistent; incident prioritization gap.
Asset baseline and access controls need strengthening.
Monitoring coverage good; policy enforcement inconsistent.
Patching posture and centralized logging retention require improvement.

conclusion: Posture is developing: strong detection and automated endpoint remediation but elevated web activity, concentrated Windows 11 assets, and a small set of high‑risk users increase exposure. Priorities: 1) tighten endpoint tamper protection and telemetry, 2) enforce CASB/DLP for top apps/users, 3) remediate high‑risk users and validate asset patching.
